newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel barge premiums dip.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel barge premiums dip.

text.p: NWE jet fuel barge premiums dipped on Friday on flaccid demand but those for cargoes were notionally steady in thin volumes, traders said.
A barge traded for $249 outright early on, then equivalent to Dec +$28.50, down around $1 from Thursday.
Outright prices firmed over the day, with Dec IPE benchmark futures up $2 at $221.25.

Barge traders saw buyer resistance and a slight rise in supply. Smaller cargoes were steady at Dec +$31.50 with larger ones at Dec +$30.5 but some see pressure in late Nov from expected transatlantic and Middle East arrivals. In the Med, non-Libyan was around quotes high cif +$5.
